legend.0: Errors are ignored, swallowed, or the function panics on recoverable errors
legend.1: Errors are returned but with ad hoc inline error strings and some checks are missing
legend.2: Errors are consistently checked and returned; mostly uses sentinel Err* variables with minor deviations
legend.3: Every error path checked and returned, only package-level sentinel Err* variables, matching the (bool, error) validation contract

legend.0: Most fields unchecked or checked with naive comparisons
legend.1: Some fields validated with helpers, several fields skipped or checked ad hoc
legend.2: Most fields validated with the proper helpers, one or two gaps
legend.3: Every field validated with the designated helper and the base transaction validated first

legend.0: No doc comment and no inline comments
legend.1: Doc comment missing or not starting with the method name; few inline comments
legend.2: Doc comment present and correct; some inline comments
legend.3: Doc comment present and correct; each logical block has a concise explanatory comment
